owner.claim_generation: Captured only from the future atomic claim response and used for heartbeat and generation-fenced release.
owner.repair_flow: Fresh repair IDs use the v9 namespace; recoverable staging, server, and endpoint failures retain the claim and wait for a hash-bound request.
owner.bounded_children: Pool, SSH, SCP, Docker, repair, endpoint, retrieval, and release children are bounded by release_by_utc.

v9_repairs.retain_local_assignment: scope, diagnostic, and repair ID are assigned in separate local statements under set -u.
v9_repairs.manifest_stdin_isolation: Every SCP invocation redirects stdin from /dev/null so it cannot consume the checkpoint-manifest loop.
v9_repairs.import_correct_module_staging: inputs/activated_multiresolution_global_kv.py is staged as guest input multiresolution_global_kv.py, matching the hook import.
v9_repairs.guest_checkpoint_integrity: Before image pull or server launch, guest Python streams SHA-256 for every manifest row and atomically writes CHECKPOINT_INTEGRITY.json containing all eight verified rows and the manifest digest.
